description: configuration-overview.md's Table 1 (Configuration Levels) has several 'Changeable?' cells corrupted by a markdown-conversion defect: two sentences are merged with no separating punctuation or whitespace, e.g. 'Yes, file-editRestart required' and 'Yes by the Admin REST APINo restart, but **not persisted**'. The restart/persistence axis for Node, System properties, Logging properties, Database and Replication properties levels is present in the source but not cleanly machine-extractable from this table without consulting the original AsciiDoc.
